race.comment: ABOUT TURN (3) was solid on resumption at Belmont and now draws a much better barrier. Noske takes the ride, replacing the apprentice hoop and the inside barrier is a big tick for his chances. Just missed in a similar set-up when second-up last campaign and sharp improvement is on the cards. DIAMOND CHOUX (7) is third-up now and gets CJP in the saddle. Drawn out again, but she should be hitting her peak fitness now and she can storm home over the top. ZERO TO SIXTY (4) is better than he's shown his past couple, getting back and failing at Northam last time on the quick turnaround. May be able to sit a touch closer this time around and the form out of his recent starts has worked out well. Can improve. SHE'S SOME CRAIC (8) disappointed last start but the fresh run was solid. Can bounce back to his best form. TANUNDA (5) won't be far away.
